mapper.delete: DELETE FROM DEFECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.defect.deleteDef */ WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.defect.selectDef */ D.ID as id, D.TEST_ID as testId, T.NAME as testName, /* 테스트 이름 추가 */ D.NAME as name, D.DESCRIPTION as description, D.PRIORITY as priority, D.STATUS as status, D.CREATED_AT as createdAt, D.ASSIGNEE as assignee, D.FIX_DUE_DATE as fixDueDate, D.FIXED_DATE as fixedDate, D.REMARKS as remarks, D.IS_DELETED as isDeleted FROM DEFECT D LEFT JOIN TEST T ON D.TEST_ID = T.ID /* 테스트 테이블과 조인 */ WHERE D.ID = #{id}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.defect.selectListDefect */ ID AS id, TEST_ID AS testId, TEST_NAME AS testName, -- TEST 테이블에서 조인하여 가져온 테스트 이름 NAME AS name, -- Defect 이름 DESCRIPTION AS description, PRIORITY AS priority, STATUS AS status, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, ASSIGNEE AS assignee, USER_NAME AS userName, -- ASSIGNEE(담당자)의 이름 FIX_DUE_DATE AS fixDueDate, FIXED_DATE AS fixedDate, REMARKS AS remarks, IS_DELETED AS isDeleted, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt -- Defect 테이블에 있다면 추가 가능 FROM ( SELECT S.*, CEIL( (@ROWNUM:=@ROWNUM+1) / #{pageSize} ) AS PAGE FROM ( SELECT D.ID, D.TEST_ID, T.NAME AS TEST_NAME, D.NAME, D.DESCRIPTION, D.PRIORITY, D.STATUS, D.CREATED_AT, D.ASSIGNEE, U.NAME AS USER_NAME, D.FIX_DUE_DATE, D.FIXED_DATE, D.REMARKS, D.IS_DELETED, D.UPDATED_AT FROM DEFECT D LEFT JOIN TEST T ON D.TEST_ID = T.ID LEFT JOIN USERS U ON D.ASSIGNEE = U.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 ) S, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP ) A WHERE PAGE = #{pageIndex}
SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.defect.selectListCountDef */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM DEFECT WHERE 1=1
